purpose: Named equipment_additions for skilling XP outfits that exist only as activity pointers (or not at all) in regional-skilling-unlocks after prior 2026-07-25/26 region files. Complements activity rows; does not re-author existing equipment ids.

skip_combat: refined anima core of Zaros/Zamorak/Sliske — combat armour, not skilling XP outfit
policy.region_rule: region_hint is the practical self-sufficient acquisition geography for League planning. Elite Invention fragment outfits are global craft once fragments exist — region_hint still marks the best associated hub or pressure.
policy.outfit_rule: Gameplay acquisition only. Do not treat Treasure Hunter or DXP Token Store as the League path.
policy.id_rule: Skip if the same id already exists as equipment in regional-skilling-unlocks. New ids may share a name with an activity row when the activity is only a hub pointer.

skipped_already_present.diviner_activity_only: kandarin:diviners-outfit-guthixian-cache is activity — equipment row added below
skipped_already_present.shark_activity_only: kandarin:shark-outfit-deep-sea is activity — equipment row added below

equipment_additions.name: Diviner's outfit
requirements: Guthixian Cache completion with Divination XP awarded
Missing piece roll chance scales with cache score (wiki: 0.5% per point; e.g. 50% at 100 points)
effects: 1% Divination XP per worn piece
+1% set bonus when all five pieces worn (6% total)
Modified diviner's headwear path via headwear add-on for extra QoL
Free Diango / holiday-outfit reclaim if lost
equipment_additions.notes: Named equipment split from kandarin:diviners-outfit-guthixian-cache activity. Primary ironman route is Cache (not TH). Memorial to Guthix / Hall of Memories geography pressures Kandarin for efficient cache play.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface Kandarin Cache as the gameplay acquisition path. Prefer this equipment row for set-effect planning.

equipment_additions.name: Fury shark outfit (elite Fishing)
requirements: 80 Fishing and 20 Invention to craft outfit pieces at an Inventor's workbench after discovering shark outfit blueprints
54,000 shark fragments total to assemble shark + tiger + burnt tiers into fury (3,600 fragments per base piece × 15 pieces across three tiers)
Combine shark, tiger shark, and burnt shark outfits into fury
effects: Full fury set: +7% catch chance while Fishing (stacks with crystal fishing rod)
+10% chance to catch an extra fish (no XP on the extra fish; works at Prif waterfall without extra Invention XP)
50–60% chance to save bait per catch
Removes living rock creature aggression
Inherits Fishing outfit 5% XP (1% per piece) after those pieces worn at least once — even if the base fishing outfit is destroyed
Toggle consume-all vs catch-all on the head (consume grants fish XP without inventory fish; double XP if extra-fish proc also consumes)
equipment_additions.notes: Equipment split from thin kandarin:shark-outfit-deep-sea activity. Fragments are global Invention from Fishing; Kandarin Deep Sea hub remains the practical high-volume fishing association. Do not invent fragment rates.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Gameplay path is Invention fragments, not TH. Pair with Living Rock Caverns tolerance needs and crystal rod (Tirannwn) as optional stacks.

equipment_additions.name: Nature's sentinel outfit
requirements: 70 Woodcutting to collect sentinel fragments; 80 Woodcutting and 20 Invention to craft oaken/willow/maple pieces
54,000 sentinel fragments total for the three base outfits then combine into Nature's sentinel
effects: Full set: 7% increased Woodcutting success chance
7% increased bird's nest and crystal geode chance (stacks with strung rabbit foot, Woodcutting cape, tree-shaking scrimshaw)
Optional auto-burn (Firemaking XP) or auto-fletch-and-consume (Fletching XP) on cut logs — 25% chance, additive with Inferno adze; level gates still apply
Inherits lumberjack outfit XP (1% per sentinel piece) after lumberjack worn once — even while lumberjack is banked (wiki notes a bugged 1% baseline on some worlds)
20 daily teleports to Woodcutting locations via helm (elder, magic, yew, ivy, acadia, overgrown idols, Havenhythe creeping ivy / eternal magic destinations added 2026)
Contact active Evil Tree via helm (miniature evil tree daily spawn removed in March 2026 DailyScape overhaul)
equipment_additions.notes: No prior equipment row. Fragment craft is global; region_hints mark major tree-teleport and training geography, not a hard exclusive region. Complements morytania:lumberjack-outfit for the inherited XP layer.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not hard-gate the finished outfit to one region. Prefer Invention fragment path; skip TH.

equipment_additions.name: Magic golem outfit
requirements: 70 Mining for gemstone golem fragments; 80 Mining and 20 Invention to craft sapphire/emerald/ruby golem pieces
54,000 gemstone golem fragments total then combine three outfits into magic golem
effects: Full set: +5% Mining critical-hit chance
+1 rockertunity multiplier
Removes living rock creature aggression (pairs with Asgarnia LRC)
Daily teleport to active Shooting Star crashed star (from magic golem head)
Inherits owned Varrock armour double-ore behaviour after that armour worn once
Inherits highest golden mining suit XP (up to 6%) after full suit worn once and stored in bank/armour case — not while destroyed at Diango without re-equip
equipment_additions.notes: Not previously an equipment id. Asgarnia LRC tolerance is a key use-case; Fremennik golden mining suit is the XP inheritance source. Fragment acquisition is global Mining Invention.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Cross-region pressure (LRC + golden suit + Invention). Prefer fragment craft over TH.

+1% set bonus when full set worn (5% total)
Applies to ivy, Evil Tree, overgrown idols, clan woodcutting plots, Tai Bwo Wannai spars/fences as documented on wiki
Free Diango reclaim if piece dropped and not picked up during trek
equipment_additions.notes: Equipment split from morytania:temple-trekking-skilling-outfits activity. Nature's sentinel inherits this XP layer after lumberjack worn once.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Temple Trekking. Resolve In Aid of the Myreque via quest auto-completion overlay.

+1% set bonus when all five pieces worn (6% total)

equipment_additions.name: Master farmer outfit

80 Farming and 20 Invention; 54,000 master farmer fragments to craft animal + crop + tree tiers then combine
effects: Inherits farmer's outfit XP if that set owned and worn once

Protection payment discount (reduce by 2, min 1)
Rapid Growth up to twice per patch per day
10% chance bonus produce on fruit trees and bushes
Conditional teleports (Manor Farm with Ardougne cloak 2+, Habitat with juju bag/witchdoctor, Morytania allotment with modified farmer hat, grand seed pod teleports if owned)

Or Great Orb Project: 15,000 Runecrafting guild tokens per piece (60,000 full set) from Wizard Elriss
